name: New articles get indexed
goal: A new blog article or language edition goes live on virev.ai every day and answers 200, and Google indexes each new one within 3 days. Every miss has a live fix job pushing changes; the older unindexed backlog, IndexNow and the ledger are detail lines.

metrics.label: Days since a new article went live
Articles from the last 14 days still unindexed 3+ days after going live
Data sources that failed (sitemap, pages, Search Console)

onMiss: Every run works in auto-sns-agent's SEO program (apps/llm-wiki/content/sessions/2026/10/02/0040-virev-seo-agent/program), under its brief.md rules. Each missed metric gets one fix step under p56 with duty "d2/<metric key>" and a live job. days_since_new_article lands and promotes the next built article, or writes the next one from opportunities.md, one subagent per article. new_unindexed_3d finds why Google has not indexed each listed article and ships the fix. source_errors fixes the read this run, or goes to a "seo sources fix" step. Also run `seo indexnow --new` when the detail lists unsent URLs, and score each overdue ledger check. A step whose job is live (agent_observe.list_agents) gets the new numbers and flagged lines by message; a step with no live job gets one with await rlm.create_session(brief, name=...), and the step's job is set to it. Never start a second copy. Its brief names the metric, value and target and the pages, articles or commits in the detail, and asks for shipped changes. Never end a run with a missed metric and no live fix job. apps/search stays parked (c40), nothing goes outside (c37), and jobs land to staging on their own and leave prod promotes to the release owner, who walks each one with the owner (c154).
